english.title: Stop / cause to remain at rest a vehicle on a carriageway of motorway
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[stopped]_
(B)_[caused to remain at rest]_

a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on the carriageway of the **(..SPECIFY MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 7(1) of the Motorways Traffic (England and Wales) Regulations 1982, section 17(4) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 7(2) and (4) for circumstances in which a vehicle may stop on the carriageway.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) Fixed penalty ticket scheme may be applied
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) to

(A)_[stop]_

on the **(..SPECIFY NORTH, SOUTH, EAST OR WEST..) bound carriageway of the **(..SPECIFY MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..).
